events.title: Jeffrey Gaines
events.blurb: Singer-songwriter Jeffrey Gaines, known for his cover of Peter Gabriel's "In Your Eyes," plays the historic folk café. Doors open at 7:30 p.m.
events.blurbEs: El cantautor Jeffrey Gaines, conocido por su versión de "In Your Eyes" de Peter Gabriel, toca en el histórico café folk. Las puertas abren a las 7:30 p.m.

events.title: The Folk Heritage Series: The Kennedys
events.blurb: Folk-rock duo Pete and Maura Kennedy bring their close harmonies to a Sunday matinee. Doors open at 1:30 p.m.
events.blurbEs: El dúo de folk-rock Pete y Maura Kennedy trae sus armonías a una matiné de domingo. Las puertas abren a la 1:30 p.m.

events.title: 51st Annual Holiday Craft Marketplace
events.blurb: More than 120 artisans sell handmade gifts, from woodwork and wool to candles and baked goods. Admission benefits Saratoga Center for the Family.
events.blurbEs: Más de 120 artesanos venden regalos hechos a mano, desde madera y lana hasta velas y pasteles. La entrada beneficia a Saratoga Center for the Family.

events.title: Adirondack Thunder vs. Maine Mariners
events.addr: 1 Civic Center Plaza, Glens Falls, NY 12801
events.blurb: The ECHL Thunder host the Maine Mariners three times this weekend in Glens Falls, about 20 miles north of Saratoga.
events.blurbEs: Los Thunder de la ECHL reciben a los Maine Mariners tres veces este fin de semana en Glens Falls, a unas 20 millas al norte de Saratoga.

events.title: The Children's Museum at Saratoga
events.blurb: Hands-on play museum for young kids; Friday adds Science Explorers sessions at 9:30 a.m. and 1:30 p.m. for ages 5 and up.
events.blurbEs: Museo de juego práctico para niños pequeños; el viernes hay sesiones de Science Explorers a las 9:30 a.m. y 1:30 p.m. para mayores de 5 años.

events.title: Tang Teaching Museum
events.venue: The Frances Young Tang Teaching Museum and Art Gallery
events.blurb: Skidmore's free art museum; current shows include Mark Thomas Gibson's "We Are A Constellation" and "500 Dams," and the Hyde Cabinet show closes Sunday.
events.blurbEs: El museo de arte gratuito de Skidmore; las muestras actuales incluyen "We Are A Constellation" de Mark Thomas Gibson y "500 Dams", y la del Hyde Cabinet cierra el domingo.

upcoming.title: Spa City Farmers Market Holiday Faire
upcoming.venue: Lincoln Bathhouse, Saratoga Spa State Park
